description: List GitHub's curated Collections from the A-Z index at github.com/collections. limit (1-100, default 20) truncates the fixed 20-card index, so available is always 20 and partial=true when limit < 20. Returns collection cards with title, description, and URL. The page's top 'featured' spotlight is a rotating subset and is excluded for reproducibility. Reads the SSR-rendered collections page; no login required.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum collections to return (1-100, default 20). The collections page has a fixed A-Z index of 20 cards; limit truncates it (available is always 20, partial=true when truncated).（条数上限；收藏集页为固定 A-Z 索引 20 条，limit 只做截断。）
